LFGG_DimensionsByAspectRatio.description: Calculates aligned width and height for a preset or custom aspect ratio without exceeding the selected long-side limit.

aspect_ratio.tooltip: Target width-to-height ratio. Select Custom to use the custom ratio inputs.

long_side.tooltip: Maximum size in pixels for the longer output axis.

divisible_by.tooltip: Aligns both output dimensions to this exact multiple without exceeding the limit.

custom_ratio_width.tooltip: Width component used only when aspect_ratio is Custom.

custom_ratio_height.tooltip: Height component used only when aspect_ratio is Custom.

LFGG_ImageDimensionsByLongSide.display_name: LFGG Image Dimensions by Long Side
LFGG_ImageDimensionsByLongSide.description: Calculates aligned dimensions from an image without upscaling or exceeding the selected long-side limit.

image.tooltip: Image batch whose shared spatial shape is inspected.

long_side.tooltip: Maximum size in pixels for the longer output axis.

divisible_by.tooltip: Aligns both output dimensions to this exact multiple.

LFGG_ImageDimensionsByPixelBudget.display_name: LFGG Image Dimensions by Pixel Budget
LFGG_ImageDimensionsByPixelBudget.description: Calculates aligned dimensions from an image without upscaling or exceeding the selected pixel budget.

image.tooltip: Image batch whose shared spatial shape is inspected.

max_pixels.tooltip: Maximum total pixel count for the output dimensions.

divisible_by.tooltip: Aligns both output dimensions to this exact multiple.

LFGG_ResizeImageByLongSide.display_name: LFGG Resize Image by Long Side
LFGG_ResizeImageByLongSide.description: Resizes an image to aligned dimensions without upscaling or exceeding the selected long-side limit.

upscale_method.tooltip: Interpolation method used when resizing the image.

long_side.tooltip: Maximum size in pixels for the longer output axis.

divisible_by.tooltip: Aligns both output dimensions to this exact multiple.

output_tooltips: Image resized to the aligned dimensions.

LFGG_LoadAndCropImage.description: Loads one still image from the ComfyUI input directory and crops it without resampling.

image.tooltip: Still image beneath the ComfyUI input directory.

ratio_width.tooltip: Positive width component of the crop ratio.

ratio_height.tooltip: Positive height component of the crop ratio.

crop_x.tooltip: Left edge in oriented source-image pixels.

crop_y.tooltip: Top edge in oriented source-image pixels.

crop_width.tooltip: Crop width in source-image pixels. Zero width and height initialize the largest centered crop.

crop_height.tooltip: Derived crop height in source-image pixels. Zero width and height initialize the largest centered crop.

output_tooltips: Alpha-derived mask cropped to the same region.

LFGG_PowerLoraLoaderFolder.description: Applies ordered LoRAs while limiting new selections to a saved LoRA folder.

folder.tooltip: Limits future LoRA choices to this folder and its descendants.

lora_to_add.tooltip: LoRA to add as the next ordered row.

output_tooltips: Model with every enabled LoRA applied in row order.
CLIP with every enabled LoRA applied in row order.

LFGG_SaveImageDynamic.description: Saves PNG image batches beneath the ComfyUI output directory using safe path and filename templates.

images.tooltip: Image batch to save as PNG files.

path_template.tooltip: Output-relative subfolder template using supported brace tokens.

filename_template.tooltip: PNG filename template using supported brace tokens.

save_metadata.tooltip: Embed prompt and workflow metadata unless globally disabled in ComfyUI.

model_name.tooltip: Explicit model label used by the {model} token.
